text: I totally get it - joining a group of friends who already know each other can be intimidating. If you're feeling nervous about trying again, you might consider setting a small goal for yourself, like introducing yourself to one person or asking someone to explain a game. That way, you can get a feel for the group and decide if it's a good fit for you. And just to keep things in perspective, being quiet on your first visit doesn't necessarily mean you'll be quiet every time - people can be really different from one visit to the next.
